articles.summary: DUBLIN, IRELAND, July 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- STERIS plc (NYSE: STE) (“STERIS” or the “Company”) announced today that it will host a conference call to discuss its fiscal 2027 first quarter results at 9:00 a.m. ET on August 6, 2026. The conference call can be heard live at www.steris-ir.com
articles.title: STERIS to Host a Conference Call for Fiscal 2027 First Quarter on August 6, 2026
